comparison: Compare old/new person ID at each of three slots, not set equality.
phase1: For changed old slots: owner=0, energy=max_energy; conditionally clear occupied cell; task=0.
phase2: For changed slots: write new ID; if nonempty set owner/body/state, call rest placement, increment experience.
same_slot: Do not mutate the person or reset fatigue.
role_swap: Each moved person is removed then assigned, refills energy, increments experience.
new_person: Current energy carries over unless phase1 removed this same person.
word16: Keep raw value. These functions do not interpret it; no cooldown or unlock timer has been established.
limits: Extracted transaction semantics; full UI admissibility and natural frequency are outside this experiment.
